title: fix(lint)!: os build and the object_extension publish door judge the one-hop leaf through an extension-added lookup, and the regex and JSON-schema checks of an extension's validation rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHefYE81B7Uddo8xCtrke3d)_

Fixes #33216
Fixes #33217

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `os build`, `os validate`, `os lint` and the runtime `object_extension` publish door (Studio, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/TARGET`, the MCP and AI authoring doors) now refuse two shapes an object extension could carry before: a validation rule or formula reading `record.REF.LEAF` through a lookup an extension adds where the lookup's target serves no `LEAF`, and a `format` / `json_schema` validation rule an extension adds whose regex or schema does not compile or names an unregistered format. No exported type or signature changes. Measured first-party exposure: 0 `objectExtensions` entries add a lookup or a validation rule (`examples/app-showcase` one entry, three plain fields; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` one, a `secret` field; HotCRM `origin/main` ac4dd3d has no `objectExtensions` in code), so nothing first-party is newly refused.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none owed — this PR edits `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (the rule-table row marks the extension door, and the object extension paragraph names both checks); `skills/objectstack-data` teaches one-hop reads, `format` / `json_schema` rules and `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields })` without saying an extension is exempt from either check, so the build and the door now give the verdict the object's own declarations already get.

Precedent followed: #33154 (PR #33205), which built the extension walk these two cards extend and declared the same `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed` pair.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象扩展（`objectExtensions` / Studio 发布的 `object_extension`）补上两项对象自身早已有的检查。① 通过“扩展新增的查找字段”做一跳读取（`record.manager__c.字段`）时，目标字段名现在按“对象实际提供的结构”判定，拼错即拒，和通过对象自身声明的查找字段一样（同一规则 id `expression-invalid`、同一句提示）。② 扩展里 `format` 规则的正则、`json_schema` 规则的 schema 及其 format 名，现在和对象自身规则一样检查（同三个规则 id），位置为 `object '对象' · objectExtensions[0] · validation '规则'`。两项在 `os build` 与运行时发布口结论一致。
- **为什么改**：注册表把扩展字段和扩展校验规则合并到目标对象上，每次保存都会执行；此前拼错的一跳字段让公式恒为空、让校验规则拒绝每次保存，写错的正则或 schema 则在每次写入时被跳过，规则形同虚设，都要等最终用户保存时才暴露。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄；第一方实测 0 处扩展新增查找字段或校验规则，无既有元数据被新拒。对象自身的规则、公式与一跳读取的位置和结论不变；草稿保存不受影响，已存的行再次发布时才判。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（`refuseUndeclaredHopField` 与 `storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor` 改读 `typedObjects`）、`packages/lint/src/validate-rule-compilability.ts`（`walkObjectValidationRules` 新增的扩展循环）、`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（两条规则的 `runtimeTypes` 加 `object_extension`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts src/validate-rule-compilability.test.ts -t "33216|33217"`，预期 16 条全过：扩展查找字段后拼错的叶子字段、扩展的坏正则/坏 schema/拼错的 format 名在 build 与发布口都被拒且结论逐条相同，正确写法通过，对象自身的用例不变。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two commits, one per card.

**#33216 — `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (hop-index region only).**

- `refuseUndeclaredHopField` looked the hopping reference up on the declared `objects`, so a lookup an `objectExtensions` entry adds was never found and its leaf never judged. It now reads `typedObjects`, the served fold #30471 already builds (every extension field folded in, a field two packages tie on left out), the same fold `fieldIndex` reads for the leaf. A hop through a declared lookup reads the same definition as before, so the object's own verdicts and locations do not move.
- `storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor` takes a `served` flag. The hop refusal (`refuseStoredMetadataBodyHop`) asks for the served reading, so a hop through an added lookup into a stored-metadata-body table is refused as through a declared one. The object walk's #24677 field-reference verdict keeps the declared reading, so a field an extension adds is never charged to the object's own location. One map holds both readings (a served reading is keyed `served:NAME`), so the #5017 receiver scan sees no new receiver.
- Both sites serve the build and every door that runs the expression passes; at the `object_extension` door the written entry is folded into the door's live objects by the same fold, so the verdict is the build's.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-added-lookup-hop-leaf-judged.ts`: the ADR-0087 D3 entry. No D2 conversion: which field the author meant is a fact only the author holds.

**#33217 — `packages/lint/src/validate-rule-compilability.ts`, `validate-rule-schema-formats.ts`, `authoring-rules.ts`.**

- `walkObjectValidationRules` (the one walk both rules share, so they cannot disagree about which rules exist) also walks each rule an extension adds, through `objectExtensionsByTarget` (the fold #33205's extension walk reads: one entry per package per target, as the registry keeps them), `conditional` branches flattened in. Located at the entry: `where` `object 'T' · objectExtensions[i] · validation 'N'` (the locus #33205 uses), `path` `objectExtensions[i].validations.N.regex` / `.schema` (the entry's path in place of the object's `objects.T`), `packages[j].manifest.` prefixed in a built artifact. The rule ids are unchanged. An undeclared target is judged all the same: a regex or schema needs no field of the target.
- `validateRuleCompilability` and `validateRuleSchemaFormats` cross onto the `object_extension` door (`runtimeTypes: ['object', 'object_extension']`), together, as their #7220 family discipline requires. On that write the snapshot carries the written entry as its sole extension; the target's own rules the door's live objects carry are judged in the gate's baseline as well, so the differential charges the write with its entry's findings only.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-validation-rule-artifacts-judged.ts`: the ADR-0087 D3 entry.
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`: the "Declared enforcement that cannot run, declared on the object being written" row's runtime column now reads `✓ᵒᵒˣ`, and the object extension paragraph names both checks. Both statements were made false by this change (os-dev rule 4).
- `.changeset/33216-extension-lookup-hop-and-rule-artifacts.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor and `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, a BREAKING banner (Before / Now / Unchanged / Fix) and `adr-0087: registered` naming both entries.

## Tests

1. **`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`**, new describe `#33216` (7 cases), at the real gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`) and the build (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)`):
   - LIT: a rule reading `record.manager__c.daly_hours` through the added lookup is refused at the door at `objectExtensions[0].validations[0].then.condition`, the build's findings deep-equal the door's, and the message equals the declared-lookup case's with the reference name taken out.
   - LIT: the same for a formula field the extension adds.
   - LIT: the object's OWN formula reading through a lookup a package's extension adds is refused at the build, at the object; its control (the declared leaf) is clean.
   - LIT: a hop through an added lookup to `sys_metadata` is refused as a stored-metadata-body hop.
   - CONTROL: the correct leaf through the added lookup is clean at both doors, rule and formula.
   - A lookup two packages add at the same priority is left unjudged.
   - CONTROL: the object's own hop through a declared lookup is refused at the object save door and the build, at its own location, as before.
2. **`packages/lint/src/validate-rule-compilability.test.ts`**, new describe `#33217` (9 cases): both rules on both doors; an invalid regex, an uncompilable schema and a misspelt format name an extension adds each refused at the build with rule id, `where` and `path`; each refused at the door with the build's finding byte for byte; a `conditional` branch located at the branch; the same rule ids as the object's own (whose locations are pinned unchanged); valid rules clean at both; a sibling package's entry located at its body and an undeclared target judged; the target's own broken rule not charged to the extension write; the object save door unchanged.
3. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`**, through the real `saveMetaItem` + `publishMetaItem`: `[#33216]` 4 cases (rule and formula: a misspelt leaf through the added lookup gets 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with the build's rule id, location and path, the field is not served and the row stays a draft; the correct leaf publishes and is served); `[#33217]` 3 cases (an invalid regex and an uncompilable schema each get 422 with the build's rule id and locator, the rule is not served; valid ones publish and are served).
4. **Roster pins moved with #33217** (each lists the `object_extension` door's rules exactly): two in `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts` (#33072), two in `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` (#31998; surface amendment 6881180427).

**Ablations** (one-shot, nothing permanent; each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, then `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files; runtime pins read lint through `dist/`):

- A1, the served hop reference (`for (const obj of typedObjects)` → declared `objects`): lint 3 of 94 red, runtime 2 of 40 red, exactly the five #33216 LIT cases (rule and formula at both doors, the object's own formula); every control green.
- A1b, the served stored-metadata-body reading (`storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor(objectName, true)` → declared): lint 1 red, the stored-metadata-body LIT; runtime 40/40.
- A2a, the extension loop of the shared walk (entries filtered to none): lint 6 red (the five #33217 build and door LITs and the sibling case, plus the #5096 receiver meta-test, which reds on the marker's own `entries.filter` spelling, not on behaviour), runtime 2 red (the regex and schema door LITs); the controls, the differential case and the object door green.
- A2b, the door crossing (`validateRuleCompilability`'s `runtimeTypes` back to `['object']`): lint 7 red (the door LITs, the roster pins, the `rulesRun` controls), runtime 2 red (the door LITs).
- Restore after each: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty (the tool's verdict). Lint was rebuilt after the last leg; no marker remains in `packages/lint/dist` (`grep` 0 files for each of the four) and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Exposure measured:** `git grep` of `objectExtensions` / `defineObjectExtension` over `examples/`, `packages/` (non-test) and HotCRM `origin/main`: two entries, neither adds a lookup or a validation rule. Every test file in `packages/metadata-protocol` (7 files, 251 tests) and `packages/runtime` (7 files, 136 tests) that publishes or reads an `object_extension` passes at the head.
- **Not changed, by the order's fence:** the null-guard index (`buildNullableFieldIndex`) and the `extensionWrite` strip, which are #33246's; #33153 (a formula cycle an extension adds) and #33101 are not folded.
- **A reference an extension redeclares on the target** (the same field name, a different `reference`) is now read as served at a hop site, which is what the engine plans. The object walk's own field-reference verdict still reads the declared field, so such a field is not charged to the object's location.
- **Boot-registered module packages** (`defineStack({ objectExtensions })` through `registerApp`) are not gated, as an object's own rules are not.

## Verification

Head `d190a7f0` (base `87330e89`); `git diff --stat 87330e89 origin/main` over every touched file is empty at hand-over time, so no merge was needed.

<details><summary>Package tests</summary>

- `@objectstack/lint`: 208/208 files, 8902/8902 tests; typecheck exit 0.
- Runtime door files (`meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` + `packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts`): 81/81.
- Every other test file that publishes an `object_extension`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 7 files 251/251; `@objectstack/runtime` 7 files 136/136.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 109 lines)</summary>

The derivation at `d190a7f0` is 109 lines. Every line ran with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe. 107 exited 0 on the first pass. Two exited 3 (refused, nothing measured) on a missing build: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` (no `@objectstack/client-react` dist) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's dist). After a whole-repo `pnpm build` both exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `109 derived, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The record is `pm-orders/spec/33216-gates-ran.txt` in the project share.

</details>

Dogfood (the title carries `!` and `Clause-②:` the `(narrowing)` arm): full battery, the CI command (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock), no shard, on head `d190a7f0` after a whole-repo build. Result: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 464 passed and 3 skipped (467), Tests 3927 passed and 42 skipped (3969), no failures.
